name: Philly Art Center Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly art camps from June to September at Philly Art Center's studios. Kids Camp (ages 4 to 12) groups children by age to work through a weekly theme in 2-D and 3-D media with outdoor play after lunch; Tween Camp (ages 9 to 13) runs select weeks with deeper studio work in one medium, such as sewing.
refund_policy_summary: Early bird registrations are non-refundable. From January 8 to March 31, week switches or credits cost $30 and refunds $60; from April 1 to May 31, switches or credits cost $50 and there are no refunds; no changes after May 31.
special_needs_notes: Families of children with specialized supports, a 1:1 aide or therapists are asked to note it in their account and email at least two weeks ahead to plan together.
notes: 2026 weekly rates (one price for everyone): Kids Camp $485, Tween Camp $495, Tween Sewing $515; early care 8:15 to 9:00 $47 a week, late care 3:00 to 5:30 $105 a week. Camp day 9:00 to 3:00. Campers bring a lunch that needs no refrigeration. 2027 registration opens January 6 at 10 am, with details due December 28. Philly Art Center also has studios in Queen Village (514 Bainbridge Street), Mount Airy (530 Carpenter Lane) and Cherry Hill, NJ; the camp page does not say which studios host summer camp.
